summary: Voluntarily acting together with another person, personally committing or aiding and abetting rape under section 261 or sexual penetration under section 289, by force or violence against the person's will. The victim must be at least 14 and under 18.
penalty: Felony: 7, 9 or 11 years in state prison. The in-concert allegation must be charged and proved or admitted. A fine up to $10,000 may also be imposed under section 672. Sections 667.6 and 667.61 can require consecutive terms or life sentences, including life without parole for qualifying allegations; the base term is not an overall maximum. Adult base penalties are shown. Registration, restitution, assessments and case-specific sentencing rules require separate review.

title: Aggravated sexual assault of a child under 14

penalty: Felony: 15 years to life in state prison. Separate victims or separate occasions require consecutive terms under 269(c) and 667.6(d). Parole is not guaranteed. title: Arranging a meeting with a minor for lewd purposes

penalty: Ordinarily misdemeanor: up to 364 days in county jail and/or a fine up to $5,000. penalty: Felony: 2, 3 or 4 years in state prison. A fine up to $10,000 may also be imposed under section 672. Adult base penalties are shown. Registration, restitution, assessments and case-specific sentencing rules require separate review.

penalty: Felony: 6, 12 or 16 years in state prison. A fine up to $10,000 may also be imposed under section 672.
